item.description: - On a Mac with a touch display (the MacBook Pro with a Dynamic Island), Dashbar's island now starts off for new installs, so it stays out of the way of the Dynamic Island. Settings → Notifications says why, and you can turn it on anyway. A choice you've already made is kept. - On a touch display, the panel shows the open and stop buttons on servers and the Trash button on clean-up folders without waiting for a hover, and its small buttons are easier to tap. Nothing changes on other Macs. - New desktop widgets: small ones for Codex's and Antigravity's plan limits, OpenCode's and GitHub Copilot's tokens today, and a medium "Tokens today" with each tool's tokens and estimated cost. Add them from the widget gallery. - A tool switched off in Show in Dashbar is left out of every widget, and its own widget says it's switched off instead of going blank.
- Desktop widgets no longer go blank after an update: Dashbar now restarts its widget when it launches as a new version.

- GitHub Copilot support, in the terminal and as VS Code's agent: its sessions show in your workspaces as working, idle or asking permission, with notifications, the island and the menu bar like any agent. A Usage card and History show its tokens, models and premium requests, updated as Copilot works. Add Dashbar's hook in Settings → Integrations to see when a session needs you the moment it asks. - A Show in Dashbar switch for each tool in Settings → Integrations: Codex, Gemini CLI and Antigravity, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot. Switched off, a tool is hidden everywhere and Dashbar stops reading its files; switch it back on and everything returns.
